parsed.why: No trans-specific offence and recent decriminalisation via a trans claimant, with Pride and vigils; but documented impunity for a cleaver attack, employment law excluding gender identity, official hostility to LGBT migrants, thin recourse.

State-imposed universal exposure: care ban, document-marker ban, bans on advocacy and displays, Pride declared 'impossible'; hate-crime law unenforced, police hostility, a trans woman killed right after passage.

Dead-letter sodomy law, no trans offence, public Pride and an LGBT drop-in centre, case-by-case marker changes; but no statutory GI protection, contested partner-recognition compliance, and organised political hostility.

No criminalisation of private same-sex acts, but aggravated public-decency and unequal age-of-consent exposure, no protections, dozens of assaults with victim-blaming police, mob incitement, historic state raids.

No criminalisation since 1791 yet zero protections, non-functioning judiciary, documented hostility to visible LGBTI people, unresolved 2019 killing of an advocate, and pending bills threatening advocacy.
